data.name: Yashwant
data.gender_notes: Yashwant is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit yaśas, 'fame', + the possessive suffix — 'famous'. Its root is Sanskrit yaśas + vat. A classical Sanskrit name. Yashwant is a Sanskrit name meaning “Famous; glorious; renowned”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Yashwant expresses “Famous; glorious; renowned”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit yaśas, 'fame', + the possessive suffix — 'famous'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Yashwant total 30, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.

vedic_reference.note: Derived from the Sanskrit root 'yash' meaning 'to give', and 'vant' meaning 'desiring'. In Hindu mythology, Yashwant is the name of several gods, including Lord Vishnu and Lord Shiva.
